vt. 挑拨离间，向…说别人坏话；暗中(或私下)怂恿(或讽示)，偷偷唆使；[俚语]偷听

earwigging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Earwig
earwigging.translation:
vt. earwig的变形
n. [口语]责骂, 斥责, 训斥

earwigs.definition: n. any of numerous insects of the order Dermaptera having elongate bodies and slender many-jointed antennae and a pair of large pincers at the rear of the abdomen
earwigs.translation: n. 偷听者( earwig的复数形式 )

earwitness.definition:
n. A witness by means of his ears; one who is within
   hearing and does hear; a hearer.
earwitness.translation: n. [律]以耳闻情况作证的人,亲听证人
